population_note: Populations (fixed before scoring): `file_available` = test rows whose source file is in the local clone at the row's commit, the rows the v2 training used (train_v2 rows without their file were excluded from v2's fit and CV because only real positives lacked it); it is the primary population, and v1 is reported on the same rows. `all_rows` = every test row; v2 then scores the rows without their file from the function alone (the service always has the file, so this is not how v2 is deployed).

v2.name: mean-rank ensemble of (a) classical v2: HGB (lr 0.1, 31 leaves, 300 iters, l2 1.0) on analyzer features computed with the function's file, per-detector counts, file / Cargo.toml context without the era columns and 1000 chi2-selected code tokens (train_classic_v2 ctx_fixed_noera), and (b) Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B + LoRA r16 with a pairwise loss, merged (llm_classifier qwen05_final); risk = mean of the two models' percentiles against their held-out training scores

v1.name: hist gradient boosting (lr 0.1, 31 leaves, 300 iters, l2 1.0) on signed-log analyzer features + 1000 chi2-selected binary code-token 1-3 grams
